title: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-1

questions.question: The Chari Folk dance is primarily performed by women of which Indian state?
questions.solution: The Chari folk dance is a popular dance of Rajasthan, primarily performed by women of the Saini and Gurjar communities. It involves balancing brass pots (chari) on the head, often with lit cotton seeds inside, symbolizing the joy of collecting water in the desert.

questions.question: Yamini Krishnamurthy, a legendary figure of Indian classical dance, was honoured with the _____ in 2016.
questions.solution: Yamini Krishnamurthy, an iconic figure in both Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi, was honored with the Padma Vibhushan in 2016. She is a recipient of all three Padma awards and has served as the Asthana Nartaki of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam.

questions.question: Film actress Hema Malini is a trained _________ dancer.
questions.solution: The 'Dream Girl' of Indian cinema, Hema Malini, is a highly accomplished Bharatanatyam dancer. She received her training under prominent gurus and often performs dance dramas based on Indian mythology.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities is associated with synthesising classical and modern Indian dance through a theatre group called Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe?
questions.solution: Shanti Bardhan was a visionary choreographer who founded the Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe in Gwalior. He is famous for his innovative 'puppet-style' choreography in the Ramayana and for blending classical discipline with modern theatrical presentation.

questions.question: Kamsale is the folk dance of which of the following Indian states?
questions.solution: Kamsale is a unique folk art and dance from Karnataka performed by the devotees of Lord Mahadeswara. It is named after the brass rhythmic instrument (Kamsale) held in the hands, which consists of a cymbal and a bronze disc.

questions.question: Manju Barggavee was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2019 for her contribution to which Indian classical dance?
questions.solution: Manju Barggavee (also spelled Bhargavi) was recognized with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2019 for Kuchipudi. She gained nationwide fame for her role in the classic Telugu film Sankarabharanam.

questions.question: Nati is the folk dance of which of the following Indian states?
questions.solution: Nati is the most famous folk dance of Himachal Pradesh, specifically popular in the Kullu and Shimla districts. It is often performed in large circles and holds the Guinness World Record for the largest folk dance in terms of participants.

questions.question: Pandit Birju Maharaj is associated with which form of dance?
questions.solution: Pandit Birju Maharaj was the legendary face of Kathak. He belonged to the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana and was a master of Laya (rhythm) and Bhava (expression).

questions.question: Padayani is a folk dance from which state?
questions.solution: Padayani (or Padeni) is a traditional ritualistic folk dance and music from Kerala. It is performed in temples dedicated to Goddess Bhadrakali and is known for its massive, vibrant masks made from areca nut fronds.

questions.question: The traditional ‘Cheraw” dance, in which bamboo is used, is famous in ____________.
questions.solution: The Cheraw dance, popularly known as the Bamboo Dance, is a traditional cultural dance of Mizoram. It involves performers stepping in and out of bamboo poles that are rhythmically clapped together by others sitting on the ground.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan Kumari Kamala is associated with which Indian dance?
questions.solution: Kumari Kamala (also known as Kamala Lakshman) is a veteran dancer associated with Kathak and Bharatanatyam. While she began as a child star in films, she became a highly respected exponent of the Vazhuvoor style of Bharatanatyam and later specialized in Kathak.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities coined the term ‘Odissi’ for Odisha’s classical dance?
questions.solution: Kabichandra Kalicharan Patnaik is the scholar and poet credited with coining the term 'Odissi' to give Odisha's traditional dance a distinct classical identity. He was a key figure in the Jayantika movement that revived the dance.

questions.question: What is the classical dance of Assam?
questions.solution: Sattriya Nritya is the classical dance of Assam. It was recognized as a classical dance by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000 and was originally developed by the saint Srimanta Sankardev in the 15th century.

questions.question: In 2006, Ileana Citaristi, an Italian Odissi dancer, was awarded with the __________.
questions.solution: Ileana Citaristi, an Italian-born dancer who moved to Odisha to learn under Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra, was awarded the Padma Shri in 2006. She was the first dancer of foreign origin to receive this honor for her contribution to Odissi.

questions.question: Ranjumoni Saikia was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2019 for her contribution to which classical dance?
questions.solution: Ranjumoni Saikia is an eminent dancer who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2019 for her contributions to Sattriya. She has played a major role in popularizing this Assamese classical form on national platforms.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian classical dancers was the recipient of the Padma Vibhushan award of 2003?
questions.solution: Sonal Mansingh was the recipient of the Padma Vibhushan in 2003. She is a master of Odissi and Bharatanatyam and was the youngest recipient of the Padma Bhushan at the age of 48 in 1992.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities is a professional Kuchipudi Dancer?
questions.solution: Kaushalya Reddy is a renowned professional Kuchipudi dancer. Along with her husband Raja Reddy and Radha Reddy, she manages the Natya Tarangini institute and has performed at prestigious venues worldwide.

questions.question: Mundari dance is associated with the tribal community of which Indian state?
questions.solution: Mundari dance is a traditional folk dance of the Munda tribe in Jharkhand. The dance is usually performed during seasonal festivals like Sarhul and Mage Parab, reflecting the tribe's deep connection with nature.

questions.question: In 1956, which of the following awards did Rukmini Devi Arundale, an eminent Bharatanatyam dancer, receive?
questions.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 1956. She was a transformative figure in Bharatanatyam and was famously the first woman in Indian history to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Manju Barggavee won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award of 2019 for which dance form?
questions.solution: Manju Barggavee is a celebrated Kuchipudi exponent. Her 2019 Sangeet Natak Akademi Award recognized her decades of service as a performer and teacher of this Andhra Pradesh classical tradition.

questions.question: Who among the following is NOT a professional Indian Classical Dancer?
questions.solution: Shreya Ghoshal is a world-famous Indian playback singer, not a professional classical dancer. Mallika Sarabhai, Shovana Narayanan, and Vasundhara Doraswamy are all distinguished classical dancers.

questions.question: Which of the following dance forms is performed by the Adi tribe of Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.solution: The Tapu dance is a powerful folk dance performed by the Adi tribe of Arunachal Pradesh. It is a war dance performed during the Aran festival to drive away evil spirits and ensure a good harvest.

questions.question: Which actress-cum-dancer was honoured with the Padma Bhushan award in 2011?
questions.solution: The legendary actress Waheeda Rehman was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 2011. Apart from her stellar film career, she is also a trained Bharatanatyam dancer.

questions.question: Mohiniyattam is a dance form of which state?
questions.solution: Mohiniyattam (the 'Dance of the Enchantress') is a classical dance form that originated in Kerala. It is characterized by graceful, swaying movements and is traditionally performed solo by women.

questions.question: Chali, Thumura and Nadu Bhangi are associated with which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution: Chali, Thumura, and Nadu Bhangi are specific technical segments or dance stances associated with Sattriya, the classical dance of Assam. These movements form part of the rigorous training and performance grammar of the dance.
